subject: Supplier enrollment: Ivalua account creation error & manual provisioning
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@oceaniclogistics.com>; accounts@oceaniclogistics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier enrollment: next steps to complete vendor setup in Ivalua

Hi Samira —

Thanks for agreeing to get Oceanic Logistics set up in our procurement portal. To get you fully live so we can issue POs, please complete the vendor enrollment flow in Ivalua and return the supporting docs listed below. I’ve attached a short checklist (onboarding-checklist.pdf).

Quick checklist (what we need to finish):
- Legal entity name exactly as on W-9 / tax filing
- Tax ID / VAT number and jurisdiction
- Banking details for ACH / wire (bank name, account number, routing/SWIFT)
- Primary invoice recipient email and billing address
- Signed MSA (I sent a DocuSign link below)

Helpful links / notes:
- Portal: https://redwood.ivalua.com/vendor/enroll 
- DocuSign MSA: https://docusign.com/redirect/MSA-OL-2027
- If you hit the email OTP step and don’t receive a code, try an alternate email address or a browser in incognito. Some corporate filters delay OTP delivery. If it still fails, reply here and we can provision manually.

Target timelines: once we have the W-9 + bank info and you’re validated in Ivalua, procurement typically issues a PO within 48 hours.

If anything is unclear I can hop on a 15-minute call — available today 11:30–12:30 PST.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@oceaniclogistics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 11:02:13 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment: next steps to complete vendor setup in Ivalua

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the checklist. I started the Ivalua enrollment just now but ran into two problems:

1) After submitting the company details I never got the OTP to accounts@oceaniclogistics.com (we checked spam).
2) The portal rejected the legal entity name — it says there is an existing record for "Oceanic Logistics Inc" which conflicts with our name "Oceanic Logistics LLC" and gives an "organization mismatch" error.

I attached a screenshot of the error (sso-error.png).

How do you prefer we proceed? We can provide the W-9 and bank details immediately but if the portal will not let us complete registration we’ll need a manual provisioning path so we’re not blocked for POs.

Samira Khan
Director, Finance Operations
Oceanic Logistics
samira.khan@oceaniclogistics.com
Attachment: sso-error.png

Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 13:06:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment: next steps to complete vendor setup in Ivalua

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the quick try and for the screenshot — that helps. We see two routes:

1) Small troubleshooting steps (if you'd like to try again):
   - Use a different registration email (personal or team sub-address), or an incognito window.
   - If the OTP still does not arrive, forward the portal error email (if any) and the exact timestamp to me.

2) Manual provisioning (we can do this immediately so you’re not blocked):
   - If you decide to go manual, please send me the exact legal entity name, W-9 / tax form, tax ID, and preferred billing email. I’ll open a provisioning ticket and have procurement create the vendor record on our side.

I’ve created an internal ticket to track this: PRO-4821 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRO-4821). I’ll also open a support case with Ivalua in parallel to resolve the Org-name collision.

If you’re okay with manual provisioning, please reply with the following in your next email:
- Official legal name
- W-9 (or local tax document)
- Tax ID / VAT
- Bank details for payments (we can redact the full account number when sending over email; we can also accept a secure upload link)

For the MSA, if you prefer to sign now I can re-send the DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/redirect/MSA-OL-2027

Ben — can you provision Oceanic as a manual vendor while we sort the portal conflict? Marissa, flagging for CS to ensure the onboarding SLA is tracked.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment: Ivalua account creation error & manual provisioning

Hi Samira —

I created a manual vendor record for Oceanic Logistics in our procurement system and exported the vendor stub for your reference (vendor-record-export.csv). You should receive a welcome email from procurement with temporary credentials to access a limited vendor portal view — that email will come from procurement@redwood.com.

Next steps for you to enable POs:
- Reply to this thread with the W-9 and the preferred billing email (we can redact full account numbers in email).
- Confirm the exact legal name you want on the PO (we used "Oceanic Logistics LLC" per your last note).

If you don’t see the welcome email in the next hour, let me know and I’ll re-send. I’ll keep PRO-4821 open until Ivalua confirms the root cause of the org collision.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: vendor-record-export.csv
